# apollo_persisted_query_list (Data Source)

Reads one GraphOS persisted query list by graph identifier and persisted query list identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apollo_persisted_query_list" "mobile" {
  graph_id = "inventory"
  id       = "pql-123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Graph identifier that owns the persisted query list.
- `id` (String) Persisted query list identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `linked_variants` (Attributes List) Variants currently linked to the persisted query list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--linked_variants))
- `name` (String) Persisted query list name returned by GraphOS.

<a id="nestedatt--linked_variants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `linked_variants`

Read-Only:

- `graph_id` (String) Graph identifier of the linked variant.
- `variant` (String) Variant name linked to the persisted query list.
